messages:
maria (infra): Quick sync — need a decision on GPU lifecycle and region commit for the EU onramp. We have two proposals: aggressive H100 commit for EU (shortens latency risk) vs mixed A100+H100 with larger spot fallback. Need launch gating criteria + cost delta for Q3 OKR.
sam (eng): can you TL;DR the numeric tradeoffs? lead times, utilization targets, cost per token impact?
ravi (supply): Lead times: H100 long pole ~16 weeks if we lock now, A100 ~8-12w depending on partner. Spot/backfill available but eviction risk for peak bursts. Pricing delta roughly 25-30% more for H100 on our preferred config.
nick (product): Customer asks driving this: 2 mid-market customers want EU <50ms tail latency for chat in production and will consider Dedicated if we can guarantee it. That increases priority — but we also need runway for Dedicated contracts.
jenna (ops): Utilization goal per OKR is 70-80% steady-state. If we commit too many H100s and utilization dips, unit cost explodes. We should size canary pool for dedicated pilots and reserve the rest as shared capacity.
maria (infra): Proposal A — Commit 120 H100 to EU, reserved for Dedicated + hosted canaries. SLA: 99.9% p95 < 60ms for chat paths, rollout gated on canary for 2 customers for 4 weeks. Budget impact +$350k/mo.
Proposal B — Commit 60 H100 + 120 A100, build larger spot fallback (ops playbook), SLA: 99.8% p95 < 70ms, rollout gated on synthetic SLAs and customer smoke tests. Budget impact +$180k/mo.
sam (eng): From runtime perspective Proposal B needs more software control (hot/warm routing, tighter KV cache segregation). Implementation risk +2 sprints.
ravi (supply): If we pick A, we can start procurement for A100 immediately and stage H100 in wave 2. That reduces near-term cash and shortens lead time for minimum capacity.
nick (product): Customer negotiation: we can promise Proposal A to the two mid-market customers but need a runway for pricing/discounts. Proposal B likely acceptable if we offer a performance SLA add-on and a migration path.
jenna (ops): Ops checklist for both: monitoring per-tenant tail latency, token-level cost attribution, autoscale policies with burst contracts. Need runbook for spot eviction: immediate fallback to NA region and queue degrade flow.
deploy-bot: Scheduled procurement vote created: /vote "EU H100 commit" closes in 48h
maria (infra): Action items I propose: (1) risk/cost matrix by EOD tomorrow (2) canary plan + gating tests (3) procurement ask drafts for finance. Also need to map to Q3 OKRs (utilization + SLA).
sam (eng): I'll own the canary plan and the extra runtime work estimate. ETA 5 working days.
ravi (supply): I'll get firm vendor lead times & provisional pricing in 2 days.
nick (product): I'll draft the customer commit language and discount thresholds. 2 days.
jenna (ops): I'll draft the runbook + monitoring dashboard spec. 3 days.
maria (infra): Quick vote now please: react with :thumbsup: for Proposal A (aggressive H100), :thumbsdown: for Proposal B (mix + spot). We need 3+ approvals to proceed with procurement ask.
sam (eng): :thumbsup:
ravi (supply): :thumbsdown:
nick (product): :thumbsup:
jenna (ops): :thumbsdown:
maria (infra): Tally so far: 2 ups / 2 downs. Leaving a note — if we go A we accept higher burn but straight path for latency SLA and faster Dedicated onboarding. If B we trade performance for cost and lower lead-time risk.
jenna (ops): Also flag: escalation path when spot evictions coincide with regional outage — need cross-region fallback testing in canary.
maria (infra): Agree. We should include a 2-week cross-region failover test in the gating.

Decision table (draft):
```
Priority | Region | SKU  | Commit | SLA (p95)
P0       | EU     | H100 | 120    | <60ms
P1       | EU/NA  | mix  | 60H/120A | <70ms
```

maria (infra): We'll reconvene after the vendor numbers land. If vendor pricing tightens, leaning B. If customers push, leaning A. Record votes here for procurement thread.

sam (eng): noted, updating the canary plan doc and will ping when ready.
jenna (ops): I'll add cross-region failover to the gating tests.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: procurement vote closes in 48h — please finalize reactions.
